summary: Completed full zero-UI Google Search discoverability, indexing, and crawl health architecture plan across all 4 tiers for DECK / divider — Pokémon TCG Studio. Implemented universal indexability gate, canonical 301 apex and alias normalization, clean sitemap index and child sitemaps, Google Site Names and Organization JSON-LD, removal of deprecated FAQPage/AggregateRating schemas, duplicate body elimination in view-source, conditional caching headers (ETag, Last-Modified, short HTML TTL), and automated CI SEO linting.
